reviews.text: He always leaves loving the place ! Great staff and people ! Very accommodating and personable !

The pet snobs boutique is my favorite groomer to take my baby Mitchie to. They execute his haircut perfectly every.single.time. I love this place and wish I could give them more than 5 stars. They do a wonderful job cutting poodles and they have a wonderful pet shop area where I get all his snacks, clothes and accessories!
Samantha a Pet Snobs is the best in grooming my three beautiful rescue yorkies, Bella, Zoey and Lucy. They have taken care of all of my rescues, now on my third set over the years. An awesome place
I cannot say enough good things about this place! I’ve had my Husky groomed here for the last year or so and she looks perfect every time!
The staff is amazing!

I took my cat to this establish for his first grooming experience. Making the appointment was an easy, straightforward experience. The staff were very friendly, accommodating and professional. My cat can be temperamental. However, the groomer handled him with care. I am very satisfied with the outcome.

Look what they did to my Bodhi! The beautification of Bodhi. A summer cut after a lovely shampoo with cooling ingredients. How handsome can a cutie pie get? Thank you so much for your gentleness with my little buddy and always making him come out smelling super fresh and clean with a little pep in his step. You all are so generous of heart there and thank you so much again.
Booked my dog here for a grooming after reading the reviews. They did not steer me wrong. Great place, great people and great haircut!
My dogs came back with fur cut so short it looks patchy, they don’t look like themselves. Pretty expensive for poor quality.

I am pretty disappointed. They cut my pup's nail too short and it was bleeding. No one mentioned this to me, I didn't notice until I was outside. I brought him back inside and the owner told me it was the quick and totally normal. She had the groomer put quick clot on it and I left. I am not very picky about style of cut, but I do care that they hurt him. I paid $109, and I know that the groomers get 1/2. I don't think I will go back.
Samantha does a great job grooming my Cavalier King Charles. I’m honestly picky but am always happy when I get him back!

Maggie is wonderful with my Biewer Terriers and does a great job with their cut. They get excited to see her which means a lot to me that they don’t feel anxious. We sadly moved out of the city but I will always recommend Maggie to anyone looking for a high quality cut for pure bred dogs in the city.

However, the name of the boutique fits the rest of the staff. No one says greets me when I walk in and the front desk girl is always on her phone. They just look up from their phone, scream Maggie’s name, and then go back to their phone. And they are a bit weird about scheduling. I asked if we could just keep the pups on the schedule for every 6 weeks and they said they couldn’t do that nor keep a card on file. You do get a high quality cut but not the best customer service. I guess that’s what you get with a place called “Pet Snobs”.

I’m really disappointed with this grooming salon. I brought in the fluffiest puppy with a perfect coat for any haircut, and somehow I’ve gotten back the ugliest cuts every single time. I always ask for a fluffy, round face, yet parts of her face end up shaved or uneven. I can tell the groomers truly love dogs and are very affectionate with the pets, and I really appreciated that which is why I gave them three chances. But no matter how kindly they treat the dogs, the quality of the grooming just isn’t there. Customers pay hundreds of dollars so their dogs can look beautiful, not patchy or poorly groomed. Sadly, they just haven’t been able to deliver what I ask for, and I won’t be returning
I was really impressed with their grooming services! They are very accommodating and do a great job.

This is hands down the best grooming experience I’ve had. The salon is spotless, welcoming, and has such a friendly atmosphere. Everyone on staff is professional and clearly cares about the pets. Maggie does an absolutely excellent job, every time — my dog, Mello came out looking perfect, happy, and relaxed. The attention to detail and genuine care really show. Booking was easy, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. I couldn’t recommend this place more!

This used to be my go-to place for my kitty's grooming needs. The last experience, however, left me very disappointed. When I got my kitty home and took him out of his kitty backpack I noticed his hind legs were cut up and bleeding. I was appalled. Naturally I went to another groomer for his next beautifying experience and, to add to my anger, the new place was literally half the price!! I thought kitty grooming was just super expensive and one had to suck it up. Not so! To think of all the money I could have saved.

Needless to say,  I will not be returning to Pet Snobs as my kitty and wallet are happier going elsewhere where the grooming is gentle and the price is right.
Fast, friendly and very affordable. Walk right in. No waiting.

I can't say enough how wonderful my experience with The Pet Snob was this weekend with their treatment of my Paws foster dog. Everyone working at the store was lovely and very friendly and kind to myself and most importantly my dog! Sierra did an amazing job with Coco and was very sweet meeting her and making sure she was comfortable. Her groom was perfect and you could tell Coco felt much better after several tricky months as a foster. She's still soft days later. Also walked out with what are now the dog's favorite treats and ball thanks to the fun assortment of merchandise  at the store.

10/10 service was Top Tier! Yesterday was Toast and I first Visit and we love every moment. From the friendly service down to the pup decor! They talked to be in detail on the process and made me feel so comfortable to leave Toast. In their care! Even updated me on him through out his first grooming! We will be back in 3 weeks!
They are amazing! My cat will not let me cut his nails and they do a fantastic job at a reasonable price

We followed Sam to Pet Snobs when she left her previous job. She's always been so gentle and caring with our little senior shih tzu mix, we couldn't imagine anyone else grooming her. Our dog recently started having more frequent seizures, and unfortunately had one mid-groom. Sam was so professional when it happened, and has adjusted how she grooms her to lessen the stress. Can't recommend Sam enough!

I love The Pet Snobs!!! They listen to you and take great care grooming. My dog Kendrick Lamar had an awesome grooming experience again with Sierra and this time on his bday. My Kenny knows his looks good! Thank you Sierra and the wonderful staff. We are officially returning customers.
Maggie does a beautiful job grooming my Pomeranian!

We travel full time and have been to groomers all across the country.

This was by far the best experience we have ever had with a grooming appointments! Maggie did a fabulous job on our doodle. He had Matts and needed to be shaved down. She did a great job with the cut and was able to keep his tail fluffy and leave length on his head which was exactly what we wanted. It was the fastest he has ever been groomed yet he looks the best he ever has after a hair cut.

Would recommend in a heartbeat and this is a place we will be visiting every time we are staying in Philly!

This place is phenomenal! The groomers do an excellent job and the store is just so cute! You can tell they really love animals. I've tried a few other groomers in Philly but this one in my opinion is the best. Also, I love supporting women …

The shop itself is adorable but what I came in for was nail trims for my two cats. It's hard to find this service in the city, and especially on a consistent basis. I love that their cat nail trims are a walk-in service throughout the …
This is the absolute best place for pampering your pet! Incredible service, and incredible work. I cannot recommend enough.
Amazing staff. They took care of Match
